items.title: Urbie Green interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 29, 1995
items.q: Yeah. I think he might have had a microphone, I’m not even sure.

ctx.x: Yeah. I think he might have had a microphone, I’m not even sure. I mean it wasn’t a pick-up, an electric pick-up, it wasn’t that kind of amplification where it’s attached to the
guitar. But I think he probably, well everybody had a microphone in the recording studio, although in the earlier days sometimes they did all those records with one microphone.
